findings.title: Native standalone manifest binding uses a different serialization from its immutable owning row
findings.cause: Engine manifestDigest hashes sorted 2-space JSON with a trailing newline. Owning native manifest_digest hashes compact sorted canonical JSON. Dispatch requires equality, so a valid emitted binding is refused before dispatch UPDATE/apply. The wrapper sets its local dispatched flag before the repository await, then masks the pre-child rejection as unconfirmed while the failed transaction and finish(false) restore ready.
findings.minimalCorrection: Use the canonical controlplane digest for native standalone binding.manifestDigest creation and authenticateSettlement manifest comparison only. Preserve objectHash in existing plan artifact cipher refs, config/backend/executable digests, settlement digest/ref and payload serialization; preserve every native current source/product/member/approval/lease CAS.

findings.title: Two genuine producer method-tampering controls expect the wrong refusal message
findings.cause: Finite producer refuses the own init/plan shadow; runner finally independently detects the same compromised known run and emits Canonical standalone run origin changed. The existing substring settlement expectation does not match this canonical refusal.
findings.minimalCorrection: Retain both literal case identities and negative behavior. Assert the exact canonical origin refusal plus zero execution of the shadow backend-override callback, no local state, no settlement, and unchanged original artifact. Do not loosen production origin/finally checks.
